'''Wayne Waitman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 San Diego Comic-Con Open]] on 21 July 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops]], according to Tim Guzman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1037">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-25-comic-con-open-2000d1037/ comic-con-open-2000], DeckTech (Tim "Info Broker" Guzman, 25 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-25-comic-con-open-2000d1037/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
